events.name: Quiet Travel
events.description: You travel for a time without incident. The road (or path) stretches on.

events.name: Wildlife Encounter
events.description: You spot animals in the distance. Most keep their distance.

events.name: Sudden Ambush
events.description: Something moves too quickly. You are under attack before you can fully react.

events.name: Hidden Cache
events.description: You notice something unusual — a loose stone, a buried box, or a forgotten pack.

events.name: Traveling Merchant
events.description: A merchant with a heavily loaded mule greets you and offers to trade.

events.name: Strange Occurrence
events.description: Something feels wrong — or at least unusual. The air shifts. A sound doesn’t belong.

events.name: Old Inscription
events.description: You find writing or carvings left by someone long gone. Time has worn them, but meaning remains.

events.name: Safe Rest
events.description: You find a sheltered spot and manage a proper rest.

events.name: Bad Footing
events.description: The ground gives way slightly, or a branch snaps at the wrong moment. Minor trouble.

events.name: Unexpected Opportunity
events.description: A chance presents itself — information, a temporary alliance, or a valuable item left unattended.

events.name: Dangerous Presence
events.description: You feel it before you see it. Something strong is nearby, and it has noticed you.
